title: Shelf Builders
can_do: 合作做事时分好“你做什么、我做什么”，并守好自己的部分。

conversation_move.label: divide tasks and hold one's own part

trigger: A new bookshelf needs assembling, and Dad shares the work with Child.
setting: Assembling furniture on the living-room floor.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Our new bookshelf needs building today.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Can I help? What do I do?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: You can sort the pieces by size.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Big ones here, small ones there. Done!

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Now hold this side steady for me.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Holding steady! Which piece comes next?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: The long white shelf goes on top.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Then my dinosaur books get the top shelf!

replay_cards.title: Garden helpers
replay_cards.change: Many small jobs and only two helpers.
replay_cards.challenge: Child divides the tasks — he waters, Dad digs — and they check the plan together before starting.

replay_cards.title: The craft cleanup
replay_cards.challenge: Child assigns paper scraps to one bin and blocks to the other, and they finish the cleanup together.

parent_support: 家务和手工故意留一半给孩子：“你负责哪块？我负责哪块？”
分工后各干各的，中途不越界接管，让孩子守住自己的责任。
完工后击掌并各自复述“我做了什么”，体验合作成果。
